audience: podcast, research and media teams that turn recordings into transcripts and captions in Sonix

useCases.title: Transcribe a recording from a public URL
useCases.text: Start transcription of a media file at a public URL, then check its status until it is completed.

useCases.title: Get captions and transcript text
useCases.text: Read the plain-text transcript, or SRT and VTT captions, of a completed media file.

useCases.title: Summarize an interview with AI
useCases.text: Start an AI summary or a custom prompt on a completed transcript, then read the summary when it is done.

useCases.title: Translate and export finished media
useCases.text: Start a translation or an audio or video export, then check its status until it is completed.

useCases.title: Find media that is still processing
useCases.text: List the media files, filter them by status, and list the folders they belong to.
